text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. In supervised learning, a model is trained using labelled examples called training data. Each example contains an input and the correct output. During training, the model looks for patterns that connect inputs to outputs. Once training is complete, the model can make predictions about new, unseen data. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy. A higher accuracy means the model is better at giving correct answers.
